decisions.reason: The connector-placement change does not alter the three-board architecture or the assigned roles and exclusions of the main and sensor boards.
The source changes lower-connector placement and orientation, not ESP32 pin coverage, breakout format, or breakout-hole placement.
The source concerns lower connectors on the main board and does not change the power board's dimensions, mounting, orientation, or connector clearances.
Placing lower connectors beneath the upper row does not change the requirement to place the ESP32 antenna at the PCB edge.
The rearrangement may support routing, but it does not change the current 70 by 50 mm board dimensions or the allowance to adjust prototype dimensions.
The main-board connector arrangement does not alter the power board's four-layer stack or ground-plane strategy.
The source changes physical placement of lower connectors on the main board, not the sensor board's connector inventory, types, pinouts, or count.
The source does not identify the charge-status connector or change its circuit, resistor, LED population, or indication path.
The source does not identify J_RESET and does not alter the panel reset control's connector, electrical action, or off-board implementation.
Physical placement and orientation of lower connectors do not change the interboard power topology, connector types, matching rule, or pinout.
The source does not identify J_PWR_BTN and does not change the panel power button's signal, behavior, connector type, or board assignment.
The source does not identify the panel GPIO connectors and does not alter their GPIO assignments or off-board control behavior.
